description: This file is a JavaScript source file that provides a jQuery adapter for CKEditor, enabling easy integration of CKEditor with jQuery elements, event handling, and API access.

methods.name: jQuery.fn.ckeditor
methods.description: Initializes CKEditor instances on matched elements (textarea, div, p), binds event handlers, and manages synchronization with jQuery.

methods.name: jQuery.fn.ckeditorGet
methods.description: Retrieves the existing CKEditor instance for the first matched element.
